title: Quentin and the Ghost
author: Bram Sterling
blurb: August Lockridge, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
